calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as member_net_sales,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(f.net_amount), 2) as member_share_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, calendar_date
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = CAST('2026-10-15' AS DATE)

SELECT MIN(calendar_date) as earliest, MAX(calendar_date) as latest
FROM dim_date

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(*) as total_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as member_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN f.member_key IS NULL THEN 1 END) as guest_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_period,
    MIN(net_amount) as min_amount,
    MAX(net_amount) as max_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_lines,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN net_amount = 0 THEN 1 END) as zero_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10, 11)
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_period
ORDER BY fiscal_period
